# Setup

Install `dodo` (if needed):

```{r install-dodo, output=FALSE}
renv::install("Louis-Backstrom/dodo")
```

```{r dodo-version}
cat("Using dodo version", as.character(packageVersion("dodo")))
```

Load libraries:

```{r load-libraries}
library(dodo)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(future)
library(furrr)
library(scales)
library(ggh4x)
```

Get models:

```{r get-models}
models <- read_xlsx("Paper/EDE Papers.xlsx", sheet = 2, range = "D2:T50") %>%
  fill(everything(), .direction = "down") %>%
  filter(`R?` == "✓", Uncertainty != "None") %>%
  pull(ID)
```

Set up parallel processing:

```{r setup-parallel}
plan(multisession, workers = floor(parallel::detectCores() * 0.75))
# plan(sequential)
```

Set key parameters:

```{r overwrite}
overwrite <- FALSE
```

```{r parameters}
alpha <- 0.05
beta <- 0.2

eps <- 0.5
p_i <- 0.7
p_r <- 0.5

pse <- eps * p_i * p_r

certainty_classes <- tibble(
  class = c("X", "Y"),
  beta_1 = c(25, 2),
  beta_2 = c(1, 3),
  certain = c(TRUE, FALSE)
)

certainty_threshold <- 0.9

extinction_time <- 100

iterations <- 1:10
test_times <- seq(0, 100, by = 1) + extinction_time

grid <- expand.grid(test_time = test_times, iteration = iterations)
```

Set up functions for records, surveys, and effort:

```{r functions}
rtruncbeta <- function(n, shape1, shape2, min = 0, max = 1) {
  u <- runif(n, pbeta(min, shape1, shape2), pbeta(max, shape1, shape2))
  return(qbeta(u, shape1, shape2))
}

create_records <- function(extinction_time, pse, test_time) {
  repeat {
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(certainty_classes))) {
      beta_pars <- c(certainty_classes$beta_1[i], certainty_classes$beta_2[i])

      if (certainty_classes$certain[i] == TRUE) {
        counts <- rpois(extinction_time, pse)
      } else {
        counts <- rpois(test_time, pse)
      }

      records <- rep(seq_along(counts), counts)

      if (length(records) == 0) {
        records <- data.frame(
          time = numeric(0), p_ci_min = numeric(0), p_ci = numeric(0),
          p_ci_max = numeric(0), class = character(0)
        )
      } else {
        if (certainty_classes$certain[i] == TRUE) {
          scores <- rtruncbeta(
            n = length(records),
            shape1 = beta_pars[1],
            shape2 = beta_pars[2],
            min = certainty_threshold,
            max = 1
          )
        } else {
          scores <- rtruncbeta(
            n = length(records),
            shape1 = beta_pars[1],
            shape2 = beta_pars[2],
            min = 0,
            max = certainty_threshold
          )
        }

        records <- data.frame(
          time = records, p_ci_min = scores, p_ci = scores,
          p_ci_max = scores, class = certainty_classes$class[i]
        )
      }

      if (i == 1) {
        all_records <- records
      } else {
        all_records <- rbind(all_records, records)
      }
    }

    all_records <- sort_by(all_records, ~time)

    dodo_records <- convert_dodo(all_records,
      init.time = 1, test.time = test_time,
      threshold = certainty_threshold, unique = FALSE, aggregate = "max",
      time = "time", certainty = "p_ci",
      certainty_lower = "p_ci_min",
      certainty_upper = "p_ci_max"
    )

    umcb <- data.frame(time = 1:test_time)

    for (class_i in certainty_classes$class) {
      counts <- table(factor(
        all_records$time[all_records$class == class_i],
        levels = 1:test_time
      ))

      umcb[[paste0("records_", class_i)]] <- as.integer(counts > 0)
    }

    dodo_records$umcb <- umcb

    lee1 <- dodo_records$iucn %>%
      mutate(
        certainty = if_else(
          certainty > 0,
          floor(certainty * 10) / 10 + 0.05,
          certainty
        ),
        certainty_lower = if_else(
          certainty_lower > 0,
          floor(certainty_lower * 10) / 10 + 0.00,
          certainty_lower
        ),
        certainty_upper = if_else(
          certainty_upper > 0,
          floor(certainty_upper * 10) / 10 + 0.10,
          certainty_upper
        ),
      )

    dodo_records$lee1 <- lee1

    if (length(dodo_records$ccon) > 0) break
  }

  return(dodo_records)
}

create_surveys <- function(test_time, eps, p_i, p_r) {
  surveys <- tibble(
    time = 1:test_time, survey = FALSE, epsilon = eps,
    epsilon_lower = eps, epsilon_upper = eps, p_i = p_i,
    p_i_lower = p_i, p_i_upper = p_i, p_r = p_r, p_r_lower = p_r,
    p_r_upper = p_r
  )

  return(surveys)
}

create_effort <- function(test_time, eps) {
  effort <- rep(eps, test_time)

  return(effort)
}
```

Set up functions for models:

```{r model-functions}
run_model <- function(model, records, surveys, effort, alpha, test_time) {
  out <- switch(model,
    "SL88F1" = SL88F1(records = records$ccon, alpha = alpha),
    "SS89F1" = SS89F1(records = records$ccon, alpha = alpha),
    "SS89B1" = SS89B1(
      records = records$ccon, alpha = alpha, length.out = 1e4,
      scale = 0.01
    ),
    "SO93F1" = SO93F1(
      records = records$ccon, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time
    ),
    "SO93B1" = SO93B1(
      records = records$ccon, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time, pi = 0.5
    ),
    "SO93F2" = SO93F2(
      records = records$ccon, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time, precBits = 1024
    ),
    "MA94F1" = MA94F1(records = records$ccon, alpha = alpha, gamma = 0.5),
    "BU95F1" = BU95F1(records = records$cdis),
    "BU95F2" = BU95F2(records = records$cdis),
    "BU95F3" = BU95F3(records = records$cdis),
    "MA97F1" = MA97F1(
      records = records$cdis, effort = effort, alpha = alpha,
      init.time = 1
    ),
    "MC98F1" = MC98F1(records = records$cdis, effort = effort),
    "MC99F1" = MC99F1(
      records = records$ccon, alpha = alpha,
      test.time = test_time
    ),
    "WM99B1" = WM99B1(
      records = records$cbin, surveys = 1:test_time,
      alpha = alpha, test.time = test_time, priors = list(
        lambda = 1e3, c = 1, d = 1
      ), increment = 0.01
    ),
    "RS03F1" = RS03F1(
      records = records$ccon, alpha = alpha,
      conf.int = "one-sided", k = ifelse(length(
        records$ccon
      ) >= 10, 10, length(records$ccon)),
      test.time = test_time
    ),
    "SR03F1" = SR03F1(
      records = records$ccon, alpha = alpha,
      test.time = test_time
    ),
    "MC06F1" = MC06F1(records = records$cbin, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1),
    "RO09B1" = RO09B1(
      records = records$cbin, pi = 0.5, n.chains = 1,
      n.iter = 11e3, n.burnin = 1e3
    ),
    "JE10F1" = JE10F1(
      records = records$ccon, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time
    ),
    "JE10F2" = JE10F2(
      records = records$ccon, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time
    ),
    "BR12F1" = BR12F1(records = records$ccon, alpha = alpha),
    "SO12B1" = SO12B1(
      records = records$ubin, init.time = 1, increment = 0.001,
      gamma = 1, record.check = "error"
    ),
    "TH13B1" = TH13B1(
      records = records$umcb,
      priors = list(
        p = list(p1 = 0.5, p2 = 0.5),
        q = list(q1 = 1.0, q2 = 0.5)
      ),
      certain = c(1), PXT = NULL, PE = NULL
    ),
    "TH13B2" = TH13B2(
      records = records$umcb,
      priors = list(
        p = list(p1 = c(0, 1), p2 = c(0, 1)),
        q = list(q1 = c(1, 1), q2 = c(0, 1))
      ),
      certain = c(1), PXT = NULL, PE = NULL,
      n.iter = 10e3, pb = FALSE
    ),
    "TH13B3" = TH13B3(
      records = records$umcb,
      priors = list(
        p = list(p1 = c(0, 1), p2 = c(0, 1)),
        q = list(q1 = c(1, 1), q2 = c(0, 1))
      ),
      certain = c(1), PXT = NULL, PE = NULL,
      n.iter = 10e3, pb = FALSE
    ),
    "AL14B1" = AL14B1(records = records$cbin),
    "CB14B1" = CB14B1(
      records = records$cbin, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time, n.iter = 10e3
    ),
    "CB14B2" = CB14B2(
      records = records$cbin, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time, burn.in = 1e3, n.iter = 11e3
    ),
    "JR14F1" = JR14F1(
      records = records$ucon, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time
    ),
    "LE14B1" = LE14B1(
      records = records$lee1, surveys = surveys,
      threshold = certainty_threshold, prior = c(0, 1), n.iter = 10e3
    ),
    "LE14B2" = LE14B2(
      records = records$ubin, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      n.chains = 1, n.iter = 11e3, n.burnin = 1e3, n.thin = 10
    ),
    "SB14B1" = SB14B1(records = records$ubin, init.time = 1, increment = 0.001),
    "SB14B2" = SB14B2(records = records$ubin, init.time = 1, increment = 0.001),
    "AL15B1" = AL15B1(records = records$cbin),
    "SO16B1" = SO16B1(
      records = records$cbin, init.time = NULL,
      test.time = NULL, curr.time = NULL
    ),
    "SO16B2" = SO16B2(
      records = records$cbin, init.time = NULL,
      test.time = NULL, curr.time = NULL
    ),
    "WA16B1" = WA16B1(
      records = records$ccon, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      use.mpfr = FALSE, cores = 1, pb = FALSE
    ),
    "TH17I1" = TH17I1(records = records$iucn, surveys = surveys),
    "BR19F1" = BR19F1(
      records = records$ucon, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time, n.iter = 10e3
    ),
    "BR19F2" = BR19F2(
      records = records$ucon, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time, n.iter = 10e3
    ),
    "BR19F3" = BR19F3(
      records = records$ucon, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time, n.iter = 10e3
    ),
    "BR19F4" = BR19F4(
      records = records$ucon, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time, n.iter = 10e3
    ),
    "BR19F5" = BR19F5(
      records = records$ucon, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time, n.iter = 10e3
    ),
    "TH19B1" = TH19B1(
      records = records$iucn, surveys = surveys,
      init.time = max(records$ccon) + 1, test.time = test_time,
      pi = 0.5
    ),
    "KO20B1" = KO20B1(
      records = records$cbin, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time, n.chains = 1, n.iter = 11e3,
      n.burnin = 1e3, n.thin = 10
    ),
    "KO20B2" = KO20B2(
      records = records$ubin, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time, n.chains = 1, n.iter = 11e3,
      n.burnin = 1e3, n.thin = 10
    ),
    "KO21B1" = KO21B1(
      records = records$ubin, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time, n.chains = 1, n.iter = 11e3,
      n.burnin = 1e3, n.thin = 10
    ),
  )

  if (is.null(out)) {
    stop("Unknown model name: ", model)
  }

  return(out)
}

test_model <- function(model, output, alpha, test_time) {
  out <- switch(model,
    "SL88F1" = output$conf.int[2] < test_time,
    "SS89F1" = output$conf.int[2] < test_time,
    "SS89B1" = output$cred.int[2] < test_time,
    "SO93F1" = output$p.value < alpha,
    "SO93B1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "SO93F2" = output$p.value < alpha,
    "MA94F1" = output$conf.int[3] < test_time,
    "BU95F1" = output$p.value < alpha,
    "BU95F2" = output$p.value < alpha,
    "BU95F3" = output$p.value < alpha,
    "MA97F1" = output$conf.int[2] < test_time,
    "MC98F1" = output$p.value < alpha,
    "MC99F1" = output$p.value < alpha,
    "WM99B1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "RS03F1" = output$p.value < alpha,
    "SR03F1" = output$p.value < alpha,
    "MC06F1" = output$p.value < alpha,
    "RO09B1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "JE10F1" = output$p.value < alpha,
    "JE10F2" = output$p.value < alpha,
    "BR12F1" = output$estimate < test_time,
    "SO12B1" = output$Bayes.factor > (1 / alpha),
    "TH13B1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "TH13B2" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "TH13B3" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "AL14B1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "CB14B1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "CB14B2" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "JR14F1" = output$p.value < alpha,
    "LE14B1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "LE14B2" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "SB14B1" = output$Bayes.factor > (1 / alpha),
    "SB14B2" = output$Bayes.factor > (1 / alpha),
    "AL15B1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "SO16B1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "SO16B2" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "WA16B1" = output$cred.int[2] < test_time,
    "TH17I1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "BR19F1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "BR19F2" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "BR19F3" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "BR19F4" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "BR19F5" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "TH19B1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "KO20B1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "KO20B2" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "KO21B1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
  )

  if (is.null(out)) {
    stop("Unknown model name: ", model)
  }

  return(out)
}
```

Set up output directory:

```{r directory}
dir.create(file.path("Outputs", "D2", "Extinct"),
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)
```

# Run

Generate datasets:

```{r generate-datasets}
set.seed(1234)

rse_data <- grid %>%
  mutate(data = pmap(
    list(test_time, iteration),
    function(test_time, iteration) {
      records <- create_records(extinction_time, pse, test_time)
      surveys <- create_surveys(test_time, eps, p_i, p_r)
      effort <- create_effort(test_time, eps)

      return(list(records = records, surveys = surveys, effort = effort))
    }
  ))

stopifnot(nrow(rse_data) == nrow(grid))
saveRDS(rse_data, "Outputs/D2/Extinct/simulated_datasets.rds")
```

Run models:

```{r run-models}
if (file.exists("Outputs/D2/Extinct/model_times.rds")) {
  model_times <- readRDS("Outputs/D2/Extinct/model_times.rds")
} else {
  model_times <- tibble(
    model = character(), run_time = numeric(),
    end_time = POSIXct()
  )
}

for (model in models) {
  model_start <- Sys.time()
  model_ran <- FALSE

  model_file <- file.path("Outputs", "D2", "Extinct", paste0(model, ".rds"))

  valid_file <- FALSE
  if (file.exists(model_file)) {
    check <- readRDS(model_file)
    if (!is.null(check$results) && nrow(check$results) == nrow(grid)) {
      valid_file <- TRUE
    }
    rm(check)
  }

  if (!valid_file || overwrite == TRUE) {
    model_ran <- TRUE

    results <- future_map(seq_len(nrow(grid)), function(idx) {
      iteration <- grid$iteration[idx]
      test_time <- grid$test_time[idx]

      data_i <- rse_data$data[[idx]]

      iteration_start <- Sys.time()

      warning_msg <- character()
      error_msg <- NA_character_

      output <- tryCatch(
        withCallingHandlers(
          run_model(
            model = model, records = data_i$records,
            surveys = data_i$surveys, effort = data_i$effort,
            alpha = alpha, test_time = test_time
          ),
          warning = function(w) {
            warning_msg <<- c(warning_msg, conditionMessage(w))
            invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
          }
        ),
        error = function(e) {
          error_msg <<- conditionMessage(e)
          NULL
        }
      )

      i_time <- difftime(Sys.time(), iteration_start, units = "secs") %>%
        as.numeric()

      result <- if (is.null(output)) {
        tibble(
          model = model, iteration = iteration, test_time = test_time,
          isextinct = NA, warning = length(warning_msg) > 0, error = TRUE,
          warning_msg = if (length(warning_msg) > 0) {
            paste(unique(warning_msg), collapse = " | ")
          } else {
            NA_character_
          },
          error_msg = if (length(error_msg) > 0) {
            paste(unique(error_msg), collapse = " | ")
          } else {
            NA_character_
          }, run_time = i_time, end_time = Sys.time()
        )
      } else {
        tibble(
          model = model, iteration = iteration, test_time = test_time,
          isextinct = test_model(model, output, alpha, test_time),
          warning = length(warning_msg) > 0, error = FALSE,
          warning_msg = if (length(warning_msg) > 0) {
            paste(unique(warning_msg), collapse = " | ")
          } else {
            NA_character_
          },
          error_msg = NA_character_, run_time = i_time, end_time = Sys.time()
        )
      }

      rm(output)
      gc()

      return(result)
    }, .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE))

    all_results <- bind_rows(results)

    saveRDS(list(model = model, results = all_results), model_file)
  }

  if (model_ran == TRUE) {
    m_time <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), model_start, units = "secs"))

    model_times <- model_times %>%
      filter(model != !!model) %>%
      bind_rows(tibble(
        model = model, run_time = m_time,
        end_time = Sys.time()
      ))
  }

  gc()
}

saveRDS(model_times, "Outputs/D2/Extinct/model_times.rds")
```

# Finish

Results:

```{r results}
model_files <- list.files("Outputs/D2/Extinct", pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
model_files <- model_files[!grepl("model_times\\.rds$", model_files)]
model_files <- model_files[!grepl("simulated_datasets\\.rds$", model_files)]

all_results <- map_dfr(model_files, function(model_file) {
  results_file <- readRDS(model_file)

  if (!is.null(results_file$results)) {
    results_file$results
  } else {
    warning("No results in ", basename(model_file))
    NULL
  }
})

model_times <- readRDS("Outputs/D2/Extinct/model_times.rds")
total_time <- sum(model_times$run_time) / 60
cat(sprintf("Total model execution time: %.2f minutes\n", total_time))
```

# Accuracy

```{r accuracy}
models <- read_xlsx("Paper/EDE Papers.xlsx", sheet = 2, range = "D2:T50") %>%
  fill(everything(), .direction = "down") %>%
  filter(Uncertainty != "None") %>%
  pull(ID)

all_results <- all_results %>%
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = models))

power_summary <- all_results %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  summarise(
    early = mean(isextinct[test_time < extinction_time + 10], na.rm = TRUE),
    later = mean(isextinct[test_time >= extinction_time + 90], na.rm = TRUE)
  )

saveRDS(power_summary, "Outputs/D2/Extinct/power_summary.rds")

results_summary <- all_results %>%
  group_by(model, test_time, isextinct) %>%
  tally() %>%
  group_by(model, test_time) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n))

predictions <- tibble(
  model = character(),
  test_time = integer(),
  lci = numeric(),
  fit = numeric(),
  uci = numeric()
)

thresholds <- tibble(
  model = models,
  threshold = rep(NA_real_, length(models))
)

excluded <- tibble(model = character(0))

for (model_i in unique(all_results$model)) {
  estimates <- all_results %>%
    filter(model == model_i)

  if (mean(is.na(estimates$isextinct)) >= 0.5) {
    prediction_i <- data.frame(
      model = model_i,
      test_time = min(test_times):max(test_times),
      lci = NA,
      fit = NA,
      uci = NA
    )

    predictions <- bind_rows(predictions, prediction_i)

    thresholds[thresholds$model == model_i, ]$threshold <- NA

    excluded <- bind_rows(excluded, tibble(model = model_i))

    next
  }

  accuracy_model_i <- glm(
    data = estimates,
    formula = isextinct ~ test_time,
    family = "binomial"
  )

  prediction_i <- predict(accuracy_model_i, newdata = data.frame(
    test_time = min(test_times):max(test_times)
  ), se.fit = TRUE) %>%
    bind_cols(data.frame(test_time = min(test_times):max(test_times)), .) %>%
    mutate(
      lci = plogis(fit + qnorm(0.025) * se.fit),
      uci = plogis(fit + qnorm(0.975) * se.fit),
      fit = plogis(fit),
      model = model_i
    ) %>%
    select(model, test_time, lci, fit, uci)

  predictions <- bind_rows(predictions, prediction_i)

  threshold <- (qlogis(1 - beta) - accuracy_model_i$coefficients[1]) /
    accuracy_model_i$coefficients[2] - extinction_time

  if (threshold < 0) {
    threshold <- 0
  }

  thresholds[thresholds$model == model_i, ]$threshold <- threshold
}

excluded <- excluded %>%
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = models))

thresholds <- thresholds %>%
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = models))

saveRDS(thresholds, "Outputs/D2/Extinct/thresholds.rds")

initials <- predictions %>%
  filter(test_time == extinction_time) %>%
  select(model, power = fit) %>%
  left_join(tibble(model = models), ., by = "model") %>%
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = models))

saveRDS(initials, "Outputs/D2/Extinct/initials.rds")

predictions <- predictions %>%
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = models))

saveRDS(predictions, "Outputs/D2/Extinct/predictions.rds")

accuracy_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(
    data = predictions,
    aes(x = test_time, ymin = lci, ymax = uci),
    alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = predictions,
    aes(x = test_time, y = fit),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = results_summary,
    aes(x = test_time, y = isextinct, size = prop)
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    data = thresholds,
    aes(xintercept = threshold + extinction_time),
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    data = thresholds,
    aes(yintercept = 1 - beta),
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_label(
    data = excluded,
    label = "Excluded", x = (max(test_times) + extinction_time) / 2,
    y = 0.5, fontface = "italic"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(extinction_time, 2 * extinction_time)) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(0, 1)) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none", strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(family = "mono", face = "bold")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("Test Time (Extinction at Time ", extinction_time, ")"),
    y = "Estimated Power"
  )
```

```{r issues}
all_results %>%
  filter(is.na(warning_msg) == FALSE) %>%
  group_by(model, warning_msg) %>%
  tally() %>%
  print(n = Inf)

all_results %>%
  filter(is.na(error_msg) == FALSE) %>%
  group_by(model, error_msg) %>%
  tally() %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

# Illustrative Figure

```{r illustrative-figure}
#| fig-dpi: 600
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 2
demo_iterations <- sample(seq_along(rse_data$data), 4, replace = FALSE)

demo_records <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(seq_along(rse_data$data[demo_iterations]), function(i) {
    df <- rse_data$data[demo_iterations][[i]]$records$ucon
    df$panel <- i
    df
  })
) %>%
  mutate(class = if_else(certainty > certainty_threshold, "X", "Y"))

demo_test_times <- rse_data %>%
  select(-iteration) %>%
  mutate(iteration = row_number()) %>%
  filter(iteration %in% demo_iterations) %>%
  select(iteration, test_time) %>%
  arrange(match(iteration, demo_iterations)) %>%
  mutate(panel = row_number())

ggplot(demo_records) +
  geom_point(aes(x = time, y = certainty, colour = class)) +
  geom_vline(
    data = demo_test_times,
    aes(xintercept = test_time),
    linetype = "dotted"
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = extinction_time, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~panel, ncol = 4, nrow = 1, axes = "all", scales = "free_x") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = unit(1.0, "lines")
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("X" = "darkblue", "Y" = "darkred")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, max(test_times), by = 50)) +
  expand_limits(x = 0) +
  labs(x = "Time", y = "Certainty")
```
